Description: Reads your Doman Mahjong hand and either suggests the best discard or plays the match for you.
Changelog: v0.1.3.3: telemetry channel no longer hammers the server. Pre-0.1.3.3 the 5-attempt backoff was {1,2,4,8,16}s and scan re-enqueued the file every 60s 鈥?the 31s quiet window wasn't long enough to let the server's rate limit clear, so every telemetry file tripped 429 over and over (visible in the log as upload failed ... status=429 every 1-2s). 0.1.3.3 splits the failure path: a 429 now parks the file with a .rate-until-epoch marker (default 30 min, or whatever the server's Retry-After header says, capped at 6h) and scan skips it until the marker expires. Other 5xx/transport errors keep retrying but with a longer {15,30,60,120,120}s schedule so a flaky server gets a real quiet window. The HttpTelemetryClient upload now returns an UploadResult { Success, Failed, RateLimited, Canceled } so caller can tell rate-limit apart from other failures, and parses the standard Retry-After header (both delta-seconds and HTTP-date forms). 5 new unit tests pin the marker parser, the future/past/unparseable cases, and the UploadResult factory.
